create_aligned_stone: create an AlignedStone from a reward value and aligned coordinate array
generate_possible_aligned_stones: generate a list of all 32 possible AlignedStone instances using possible_aligned_stones
apply_stone_map: apply a StoneMap to an AlignedStone to get the corresponding LatentStone
update_partial_potion_map: update a PartialPotionMap given an AlignedStone, PerceivedPotion, and result stone observation
react_stone_with_potion: compute the resulting AlignedStone when applying a latent dimension and direction to a stone
